blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Health advocates have urged lawmakers to retain the funding provision in a proposed measure seeking smoke-free and vape-free environments, warning that inadequate enforcement could leave Filipino families shouldering the rising costs of chronic diseases. Social Watch Philippines (SWP) said House Bill No. 9603, or the proposed Smoke-Free and Vape-Free Environment Act, should include dedicated funding for local government units (LGUs) to implement tobacco-control programs and prevent smoking and vaping-related illnesses. “Laws to protect Filipinos from cigarette smoke and vape aerosols will only work if local governments have the budget to enforce them,” SWP co-convenor Ma. Victoria Raquiza said […]... Keep on reading: Health advocates push funding for smoke-free, vape-free bill
